title: Lake ATX-Boat, Coffee & Views – Daily 2 hrs between 9am-12pm
blurb:
Coffee Cruise on Lake Austin

14 Passengers Max

Pick-up/Drop-Off Location:

TX-360 Loop
Austin, TX 78746
(Pennybacker Bridge Boat Ramp)

Cruise over to Mozart's get your morning delights/Coffee and lets get back on the water and breath in the fish air!

Every Boat Rental Includes:

- Experienced captain
- Full tank of gas
- 1 cooler
- Life vests for everyone
- Bimini top cover for shade
- Bluetooth stereo
- 18 ft. lilypad
- Please no red wine, glass bottles, or styrofoam cups
- Memories that will last forever your captain will captures these moments on Austin’s most scenic waters on your device.

Optional:

- Large cooler and waters for passengers
- Guests are welcome to bring their own drinks and food
- Please no red wine, glass bottles, or styrofoam cups
- Please use the above information for both the 12-person, 14-person boats, and 20 passenger boats.

For custom booking times please contact us.
